paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: The performance changes with respect to the depth of search. As a reference, we add the performance of ReFICR.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of two metrics—Recall@50 and NDCG@50—across five different search depths (1 to 5), comparing the proposed method ("Ours") with the baseline method ReFICR. The x-axis represents the search depth, ranging from 1 to 5 with integer tick marks, using a linear scale. The left y-axis corresponds to Recall@50, scaled from 0.3 to 0.6 with increments of 0.1, while the right y-axis corresponds to NDCG@50, scaled from 0.10 to 0.35 with increments of 0.05. The green solid line with circular markers represents Recall@50 (Ours), which increases steadily from approximately 0.36 at depth 1 to 0.58 at depth 5. The blue solid line with square markers represents NDCG@50 (Ours), rising from about 0.20 at depth 1 to 0.25 at depth 5. The green dotted line represents Recall@50 (ReFICR), remaining constant at 0.33 across all depths. The blue dotted line represents NDCG@50 (ReFICR), which stays constant at 0.12 across all depths. The plot demonstrates that both Recall@50 and NDCG@50 for the proposed method improve with increasing search depth, while the ReFICR method shows no improvement.
